title: Bungandidj language
extract: Bungandidj is a language of Australia, spoken by the Bungandidj people, Indigenous Australians who lived in an area which is now in south-eastern South Australia and in south-western Victoria. According to Christina Smith and her book on the Buandig people, the Bungandidj called their language drualat-ngolonung, or Booandik-ngolo. As of 2017, there is a revival and maintenance programme under way for the language.
